question: An adversary overwhelms a web service at the application layer by sending large volumes of legitimate, session-based HTTP GET requests, consuming server resources and denying access to real users, while being difficult to detect because the traffic looks normal. Which MITRE ATT&CK technique corresponds to this behavior, and why does it map to this attack pattern?
answer:
- T1499.002.
- T1499.002 corresponds to service exhaustion flooding, mapping CAPEC-488: overwhelming servers via legitimate HTTP GET sessions to deny access.
